exceptions.reason: The vulnerable analyze_string code is in the infocmp executable, removed with ncurses-bin. Retained ncurses libraries/data support Python curses and the base shell; qKVM does not process terminfo input. The runtime check rejects infocmp and the inventory gate rejects ncurses-bin. Retained source-version findings are not represented as patched.

Affects systemd-homed authentication of a forged embedded home record. Only shared libraries are installed; the runtime precondition check rejects systemd-homed and systemd-homework executables on each architecture.

Requires privileged pathname ACL operations following attacker-controlled symlinks. qKVM does not call ACL APIs, runs as UID 10001, and the runtime precondition check rejects setfacl. Library presence alone does not establish the trigger.

Only libuuid1 remains from the util-linux source package, retained for Python _uuid. This advisory concerns mount/libmount or nsenter, not UUID generation. Those executables and libmount are removed; the scanner inventory and runtime check reject their return. Package-source attribution remains visible; the source version is not represented as patched.
